errors.text_span: Die Längen der übrigen, nicht annotierten Balken fügen sich höhenmäßig zwischen dem niedrigsten beschrifteten Wert am linken Rand und dem höchsten beschrifteten Wert am rechten Rand ein.
errors.evidence: This statement is an incorrect generalization. It claims that all unannotated bars have values between the lowest annotated value (13,208 for 2008) and the highest annotated value (17,603 for 2021). However, the bar for 2009 is visibly shorter than the bar for 2008, meaning its value is below 13,208 and therefore outside the stated range.
